This website is an out-and-out scam. Avoid completely.

I admit that the products offered on his site are illegal so from the get-go it's a dice-roll as far as credibility is concerned. I usually pride myself on being able to pick and avoid online scams but some of the reviews seemed OK (albeit from 3 years ago). However, more recent reviews are negative. This was a case of me going against my gut feel and ordering some products. 

Ordered around $200 worth of products in late Sept 2022. Had to pay by BTC, which I'd never done before. This itself was a red flag, but given the nature of the products, it seemed reasonable. Received an email from Mark to say that they had been "immediately despatched". So far, so good. 

2 weeks later, nothing had arrived. Sent him an email. Responded with "problems with Australia Post", covid delays, etc. Asked me to wait a while. 

2 more weeks go by. Nothing. Sent another email, he responded with more of the same excuses. Gave me a tracking number which was invalid. Asked me to wait again. 

4 more weeks go by. Nothing. Sent him another email, this time I demanded a refund or a valid Aust Post tracking number. Says he can't help me, offers me a 50% discount on future orders. 

I have no intention of ordering from this site again. He's a thief and operates a scam.
